invention.ref: Nicolas Appert publishes airtight heat-sterilization method; Peter Durand conceives tinplate food preservation
invention.ref_zh: 阿佩尔在法国出版密封加热灭菌保鲜法；彼得·杜兰德构想出马口铁罐食品保藏

patent.ref: Peter Durand receives British Patent No. 3372 for preserving food in vessels of glass, pottery, tin or other metals
patent.ref_zh: 彼得·杜兰德取得英国国王乔治三世签署的铁皮罐头食品保藏发明专利（No.3372）

mass_production.ref: Bryan Donkin and John Hall open the first commercial canning factory in Bermondsey, London, supplying the Royal Navy
mass_production.ref_zh: 唐金与霍尔在伦敦伯蒙西建立世界首家商业罐头工坊，向英国皇家海军大规模供应马口铁肉类罐头

popularization.ref: Gail Borden patents canned condensed milk, while wars and railway expansion spread canned food to civilian homes
popularization.ref_zh: 盖尔·博登发明炼乳罐头，加之克里米亚战争与美国内战军粮采购，推动罐头食品走进全球普通家庭

sources.title: The History of the Can — Can Manufacturers Institute

summary_zh: 1810 年法国阿佩尔确立密封加热灭菌原理，英国杜兰德取得马口铁罐头专利；1813 年唐金在伦敦建立首座罐头工坊供应皇家海军，奠定现代食品保藏与储备基础。
summary_en: In 1810 Nicolas Appert perfected heat sterilization and Peter Durand patented the tinplate canister. Bryan Donkin built the first commercial canning factory in 1813, revolutionizing food preservation.
summary_ja: 1810年、ニコラ・アペールが加熱殺菌を完成させ、ピーター・デュランがブリキ缶を特許化した。ブライアン・ドンキンは1813年に最初の商業缶詰工場を建て、食品保存を大きく変えた。
